templates: Keep going — every percent counts.
You’re further than you think. Stay with it.
Small steps stack up. This year is still yours.
Progress isn’t always loud. Show up anyway.
Another slice of the year — make it count.
Momentum beats perfection. Keep moving.
You’re writing this year’s story one day at a time.
Look how far you’ve come. Keep climbing.
The year is unfolding. Be present for it.
Steady progress is still progress. Onward.
Halfway through or almost done, today still counts.
Finish the week strong. The year is watching.
Consistency is quiet, but it adds up loud.
You don't need a new year to start fresh. Start now.
Every day is a chance to move the bar forward.
Slow progress is still a step ahead of standing still.
Celebrate the small wins. They build the big ones.
The clock keeps moving. So can you.
Make the remaining days your best days.
One good week can change the whole year.
Do something today your future self will thank you for.
You've made it this far. Don't stop now.
Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
Turn the page. A new week, a new chance.
Keep showing up. That's where the magic is.
Your pace is your pace. Just keep going.
Every percent is proof you're still in the game.
Plant seeds now. The year isn't over yet.
Less waiting, more doing.
Big goals are just small steps on repeat.
Rest if you need to, but don't quit.
The best time to start was January. The next best time is today.
Progress over perfection, every single week.
Look back to see how far you've come. Look ahead to see what's next.
Your effort this week is part of the story.
Stay curious, stay consistent, stay going.
There's still time to make this year yours.
Show up for yourself the way you'd show up for a friend.
Make today count. Tomorrow will thank you.
Keep building. Brick by brick, day by day.
note: Rotated in order, one line per week (see src/message.js). Add, remove, or reorder lines freely; every line is used once before any repeats.
